title: 👕 laundry
body:
# 🧭 Steps

1. **Clothing load** — wearables, towels, bed linen; sort darks vs lights; normal detergent; softener optional on towels.
2. **Start washer** — run the clothing cycle to completion (wash + dry).
3. **Cleaning-cloth load** — bathroom, kitchen, and floor cloths only; **never** in the same drum as clothing.
4. **No softener** on the cleaning-cloth load — keeps absorbency for floor passes.
5. **Dry** — hang or machine-dry per fabric; put cloths back at their stations.

## ✅ Done when

- Clothing and towels are clean and dry
- Cleaning cloths washed separately without softener
- No mixed clothing + floor-cloth load
